messages.subject: bioc-teaching call Jan 16, 3-4pm CET
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

the bioc-teaching group call this month will take place on Monday, January 16, 3-4pm CET. Apologies again for not realising during the last meeting that this is a US holiday - if you have comments but are not able to attend on Monday, please feel free to add them to the minutes document: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1s2QMk5XA-uhBVprAO3ZDk1Yfv1cnUWLp9zdvYq9Feu4/edit?usp=sharing

The jitsi link is https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching

See you on Monday,
Charlotte & Laurent

messages.subject: course - R/Bioconductor for Mass Spectrometry and Proteomics
messages.subject_clean: course - R/Bioconductor for Mass Spectrometry and Proteomics
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

 registration is now open for the 4th edition of the course "R/Bioconductor for Mass Spectrometry and Proteomics".

 Dates: (online), March 27th-29th

Instructor: Dr. Laurent Gatto <https://lgatto.github.io/about/> (de Duve Institute, UCLouvain, Belgium) <https://lgatto.github.io/about/>

 Course website:  https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/course58/

The course will cover all levels of MS data, from raw data to identification and quantitation data, up to the statistical interpretation of a typical shotgun MS experiment and will focus on hands-on tutorials.

At the end of this course, the participants will be able to manipulate MS data in R and use existing packages for their exploratory and statistical proteomics data analysis.

 For the full list of our courses, please have a look at:  https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/

Best regards, Carlo

www.physalia-courses.org <http://www.physalia-courses.org>
